limits: Single live metadata census; other workers can create/modify evidence during traversal.
Symlink targets inventoried by hash/existence but never traversed.
File bodies not opened; no blanket content hashes, customer/secret scan, ownership or retention classification inferred.
Allocated bytes can double count hardlinks/APFS clones; logical bytes do not equal space safely reclaimable.
Own packet excluded to avoid self-counting; Git ignored content included.
